title: #312 Morning Work
prompt: Some people prefer to get up early in the morning and start the day’s work. Others prefer to get up later in the day and work until late at night. Which do you prefer? Explain it with your own experience.

promptSegments.text: Some people prefer to get up early in the morning and start the day’s work.
Others prefer to get up later in the day and work until late at night.
Explain it with your own experience.

requirements.en: Answer every direct question in the prompt.
requirements.vi: Trả lời mọi câu hỏi trực tiếp trong đề.

requirements.en: State a clear and consistent position when an opinion is requested.
requirements.vi: Nêu quan điểm rõ ràng và nhất quán khi đề yêu cầu ý kiến.

requirements.en: Develop each main idea with explanation and an example.
requirements.vi: Phát triển mỗi ý chính bằng giải thích và ví dụ.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: Starting the day early allows people time to complete personal activities like walking a dog and eating a good breakfast, leading to a calm and prepared feeling.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Starting the day early allows people time to complete personal activities like walking a dog and eating a good breakfast, leading to a calm and prepared feeling.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: Working late at night can be beneficial because the quiet environment helps people focus better and complete tasks without distractions.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Working late at night can be beneficial because the quiet environment helps people focus better and complete tasks without distractions.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: The essay argues that starting the day early is better than working late at night.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: The essay argues that starting the day early is better than working late at night.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: The essay explains that having a consistent morning routine helps people feel good every day.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: The essay explains that having a consistent morning routine helps people feel good every day.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: Getting up early provides a calm and focused time, allowing individuals to study or complete difficult tasks when their mind is fresh and productive.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Getting up early provides a calm and focused time, allowing individuals to study or complete difficult tasks when their mind is fresh and productive.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: Working late at night benefits certain people, such as freelance writers, by offering a quiet environment for deep concentration and meeting deadlines.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Working late at night benefits certain people, such as freelance writers, by offering a quiet environment for deep concentration and meeting deadlines.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: The essay explains that an early start helps build a positive routine, and a later start can improve work efficiency.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: The essay explains that an early start helps build a positive routine, and a later start can improve work efficiency.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: Starting work early is beneficial because it allows individuals to use their peak mental acuity when they are rested, enabling them to tackle complex projects before distractions build up.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Starting work early is beneficial because it allows individuals to use their peak mental acuity when they are rested, enabling them to tackle complex projects before distractions build up.

promptTraps.en: Do not write a general essay about the topic without answering the exact task.
promptTraps.vi: Không viết bài chung chung về chủ đề mà không trả lời đúng yêu cầu của đề.

promptTraps.en: Do not ignore a direct question in the prompt.
promptTraps.vi: Không bỏ qua câu hỏi trực tiếp trong đề.

faq.questionVi: Đề này đang hỏi điều gì?
faq.answerEn: Break the prompt into its direct requirements before choosing ideas.
faq.answerVi: Hãy tách đề thành các yêu cầu trực tiếp trước khi chọn ý.

faq.questionEn: How many main ideas should I use?
faq.questionVi: Tôi nên dùng bao nhiêu ý chính?
faq.answerEn: Use two developed points with explanation and relevant examples.
faq.answerVi: Dùng hai luận điểm được phát triển bằng giải thích và ví dụ phù hợp.

faq.questionEn: Can I use a personal example?
faq.questionVi: Tôi có thể dùng ví dụ cá nhân không?
faq.answerEn: Yes, if it directly supports the point and remains relevant to the prompt.
faq.answerVi: Có, nếu ví dụ trực tiếp hỗ trợ luận điểm và vẫn liên quan đến đề.

faq.answerEn: Avoid memorised general sentences and any idea that does not answer the task.
faq.answerVi: Tránh câu chung học thuộc và mọi ý không trả lời đúng yêu cầu.
